name: Karametra — Gemrazer mutated on top isn't a creature below seven devotion
notes: Gemrazer is mutated over Karametra, God of Harvests. The merged permanent has Gemrazer's characteristics plus Karametra's abilities (CR 702.140e), so 'Karametra isn't a creature' refers to the merged permanent itself (CR 201.5); the effect used to stay on the buried card's state. Its mana cost is Gemrazer's {3}{G}, so devotion is 1 + Leatherback Baloth 3 + Llanowar Elves 1 = 5: less than seven (counting the buried Karametra's {G}{W} too made it 7).
